title: Abyssals v0.90.24 — Status and Capture
notes: Sleep and confusion now independently roll a uniform 1–6 action duration on infliction, using saved battle RNG. Adds Frostbite: half Special Attack and 1/8 maximum HP damage each round, with Ice immunity, available through the new Hoarfrost Hex department-store codex. Capture strength bonuses: sleep/freeze 3×, paralysis 2×, burn/frostbite/poison/bad poison 1.25×, applied before all four capture checks and capped at 100% success. Combat, damage previews, arena AI and condition descriptions agree. Existing saves, major-status exclusivity, permanent death and encounter uniqueness preserved. Tested and signed through GitHub Actions with the original Android release key.
